defs.d: A food made from ground roasted cocoa beans.
defs.ex: Chocolate is a very popular treat.

defs.d: A drink made by dissolving this food in boiling milk or water.
(chiefly in the past participle) To add chocolate to; to cover (food) in chocolate.
To treat blood agar by heating in order to lyse the red blood cells in the medium.
Made of or containing chocolate.
Having a dark reddish-brown colour/color.
A woven fabric such as used in dressing, decorating, cleaning or other practical use.
Specifically, a tablecloth, especially as spread before a meal or removed afterwards.
Items of clothing; apparel.
The covering of a bed; bedclothes.
(ditransitive) To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
defs.ex: Waiter, please bring me a single malt whiskey.

defs.d: To supply or contribute.
defs.ex: The new company director brought a fresh perspective on sales and marketing.

defs.d: Something that is easy
Comfortable; at ease.
defs.ex: Now that I know it's taken care of, I can rest easy at night.

defs.d: Requiring little skill or effort.
defs.ex: It's often easy to wake up but hard to get up.

defs.d: In a relaxed or casual manner.
defs.ex: After his illness, John decided to take it easy.

defs.d: In a manner without strictness or harshness.
defs.ex: Jane went easier on him after he broke his arm.

defs.d: To depart; to go to another place.
defs.ex: At 9 o'clock sharp he awayed to bed.

defs.d: Not here, gone, absent, unavailable, traveling; on vacation.
defs.ex: The master is away from home.

defs.d: At a specified distance in space, time, or figuratively.
defs.ex: He's miles away by now.

defs.d: From a place, hence.
defs.ex: He went away on vacation.

defs.d: Aside; off; in another direction.
defs.ex: I tried to approach him, but he turned away.

defs.d: A piece of clothing worn on the upper body outside a shirt or blouse, often waist length to thigh length.
A piece of a person's suit, beside trousers and, sometimes, waistcoat; coat (US)
To enclose or encase in a jacket or other covering.
The part of the body of an animal or human which contains the brain, mouth and main sense organs.
defs.ex: Be careful when you pet that dog on the head; it may bite.

defs.d: The topmost, foremost, or leading part.
defs.ex: What does it say at the head of the page?

defs.d: To be in command of. (See also head up.)
defs.ex: Who heads the board of trustees?

defs.d: To come at the beginning of; to commence.
defs.ex: A group of clowns headed the procession.

defs.d: Of, relating to, or intended for the head.
(focus) Likewise.
Also; in addition.
defs.ex: There has been a cutback in federal subsidies. Too, rates have been increasing.

defs.d: People who are young; young people, collectively; youth.
defs.ex: The young of today are well-educated.

defs.d: Young or immature offspring (especially of an animal).
defs.ex: The lion caught a gnu to feed its young.

defs.d: To become or seem to become younger.
To cause to appear younger.
In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.
defs.ex: a lamb is a young sheep;  these picture books are for young readers

defs.d: At an early stage of existence or development; having recently come into existence.
defs.ex: the age of space travel is still young;   a young business

defs.d: Denotes a mingling or intermixing with distinct or separable objects. (See Usage Note at amidst.)
defs.ex: How can you speak with authority about their customs when you have never lived among them?

defs.d: Denotes a belonging of a person or a thing to a group.
defs.ex: He is among the few who completely understand the subject.

defs.d: Each of the main continuous land-masses on the earth's surface, now generally regarded as seven in number, including their related islands, continental shelves etc.
A large contiguous landmass considered independent of its islands, peninsulas etc. Specifically, the Old World continent of Europe–Asia–Africa. See the Continent.
A female person or animal.
defs.ex: I think this bird is a him, but it may be a her.

defs.d: That which belongs to her; the possessive case of she, used without a following noun.
A substance used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.
defs.ex: Aspirin is a drug that reduces pain, acts against inflammation and lowers body temperature.

defs.d: A psychoactive substance, especially one which is illegal and addictive, ingested for recreational use, such as cocaine.
To administer intoxicating drugs to, generally without the recipient's knowledge or consent.
defs.ex: She suddenly felt strange, and only then realized she'd been drugged.

defs.d: To add intoxicating drugs to with the intention of drugging someone.
defs.ex: She suddenly felt strange. She realized her drink must have been drugged.

defs.d: A member of the British Army (as opposed to a member of the Territorial Army or Reserve).
A frequent, routine visitor to an establishment.
defs.ex: Bartenders usually know their regulars by name.

defs.d: Bound by religious rule; belonging to a monastic or religious order (often as opposed to secular).
defs.ex: regular clergy, in distinction from the secular clergy

defs.d: Having a constant pattern; showing evenness of form or appearance.
Regularly, on a regular basis.
A second or subsequent reading of a text or artifact in an attempt to gain new insights.
defs.ex: I need to make a review of the book before I can understand it.

defs.d: An account intended as a critical evaluation of a text or a piece of work.
defs.ex: The newspaper review was full of praise for the play.

defs.d: To survey; to look broadly over.
defs.ex: Before I tackle the question directly, I must briefly review historical approaches to the problem.

defs.d: To write a critical evaluation of a new art work etc.; to write a review.
defs.ex: The critic reviews every new play in London.

defs.d: Making a noise, especially a loud unpleasant sound
defs.ex: the noisy crowd.

defs.d: Full of noise.
defs.ex: a noisy bar

defs.d: A member of an army, of any rank.
A private in military service, as distinguished from an officer.
To continue steadfast; to keep striving.
To serve as a soldier.
To yield, make or manufacture; to generate.
To make (a thing) available to a person, an authority, etc.; to provide for inspection.
A way or means of approaching or entering; an entrance; a passage.
The act of approaching or entering; an advance.
To incur, stand, or bear without serious detriment, as an act which might under other circumstances be injurious;—with an auxiliary, as can, could, might, etc.; to be able or rich enough.
defs.ex: I think we can afford the extra hour it will take.  We can only afford to buy a small car at the moment.

defs.d: To offer, provide, or supply, as in selling, granting, expending, with profit, or without loss or too great injury.
defs.ex: A affords his goods cheaper than B.

defs.d: To fill with wonder and surprise; to astonish, astound, surprise or perplex.
defs.ex: He was amazed when he found that the girl was a robot.

defs.d: To undergo amazement; to be astounded.
Astonished; confounded with fear, surprise, or wonder; greatly surprised. The following adposition may be: at, with or by.
A physical base or foundation.
A starting point, base or foundation for an argument or hypothesis.
Of, facing, situated in, or related to the east.
(of a wind) Blowing from the east; easterly.
An indirect cost.
To access by means of indirection; to dereference.
Not direct; roundabout.
The act of entering.
Permission to enter.
defs.ex: Children are allowed entry only if accompanied by an adult.

defs.d: To predict or believe that something will happen
defs.ex: He never expected to be discovered.

defs.d: To consider obligatory or required.
Anticipated; thought to be about to arrive or occur
defs.ex: The expected storm never arrived.

defs.d: A historical romance.
Of, concerning, or in accordance with recorded history, (particularly) as opposed to legends, myths, and fictions.
defs.ex: July 4, 1776, is a historic date. A great deal of historical research has been done on the events leading up to that day.

defs.d: Of, concerning, or in accordance with the past generally.
The act of reserving, withholding or keeping back.
defs.ex: The committee authorised the reservation of funds.

defs.d: Something that is withheld or kept back.
A bundle of thin sticks, typically made of wood, sometimes bond in such a way that binding can be moved so that it varies the tightness of the binding.
A device to turn electric current on and off or direct its flow.
A change or exchange.
To exchange.
defs.ex: I want to switch this red dress for a green one.

defs.d: To change (something) to the specified state using a switch.
defs.ex: Switch the light on.

defs.d: To determine, estimate or judge the value of; to evaluate
defs.ex: He assessed the situation.

defs.d: To impose or charge, especially as punishment for an infraction.
defs.ex: A $10.00 late fee will be assessed on all overdue accounts.

defs.d: The front part of the neck.
defs.ex: The wild pitch bounced and hit the catcher in the throat.

defs.d: The gullet or windpipe.
defs.ex: As I swallowed I felt something strange in my throat.

defs.d: To utter in or with the throat.
defs.ex: to throat threats

defs.d: To take into the throat. (Compare deepthroat.)
The thought process of considering, of taking multiple or specified factors into account (with of being the main corresponding adposition).
defs.ex: After much consideration, I have decided to stay.

defs.d: Something considered as a reason or ground for a (possible) decision.

The flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used to move food around, for tasting and that is moved into various positions to modify the flow of air from the lungs in order to produce different sounds in speech.
This organ, as taken from animals used for food (especially cows).−
defs.ex: cold tongue with mustard

defs.d: On a wind instrument, to articulate a note by starting the air with a tap of the tongue, as though by speaking a 'd' or 't' sound (alveolar plosive).
defs.ex: Playing wind instruments involves tonguing on the reed or mouthpiece.

defs.d: To manipulate with the tongue, as in kissing or oral sex.
A chief officer or administrator, especially one who can make significant decisions on their own authority.
The branch of government that is responsible for enforcing laws and judicial decisions, and for the day-to-day administration of the state.
Designed or fitted for execution, or carrying into effect.
Of, pertaining to, or having responsibility for the day-to-day running of an organisation, business, country, etc.
defs.ex: an executive officer

defs.d: To pardon; to waive any negative feeling or desire for punishment, retribution, or compensation.
defs.ex: Forgive others, not because they deserve forgiveness, but because you deserve peace.

defs.d: To accord forgiveness.
To lift, raise up.
To augment or make something greater.
A status resulting from a batter swinging and missing a pitch, or not swinging at a pitch when the ball goes in the strike zone, or hitting a foul ball that is not caught.
The act of knocking down all ten pins in on the first roll of a frame.
(sometimes with out or through) To delete or cross out; to scratch or eliminate.
defs.ex: Please strike the last sentence.

defs.d: (physical) To have a sharp or sudden effect.
